observations: Silver/grey Yamaha-branded keyboard with full-size key range, photographed at an angle.
Top panel shows a partial model label reading 'MM6' next to the brand logo.
Bottom-left corner shows two wheel-type controllers, consistent with pitch-bend and modulation wheels.
LCD screen is lit blue, but content is not legible enough to confirm the unit is powering normally.
Keys show yellowing/discoloration typical of an older, heavily used instrument.
No power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, or box is visible in the photo.
Background shows the item sitting on packaging material in what looks like a shop/storage area.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'YAMAHA' branding on the front panel and a partial 'MM6' label on the top panel.
Photo 0 shows two wheel controllers at the bottom-left, consistent with pitch-bend/modulation wheels standard on the MM6.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have faulty keys/buttons despite the lit screen.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the unit powering on from a cold start, all keys pressed in sequence, and sound output through a speaker.

risks.risk: Pitch bend/modulation wheels could be loose, broken, or not registering properly.
risks.proof: A close-up video of the wheels being moved while the screen or sound shows a response.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, pedal, stand) that are normally needed to use the unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit, no accessories

risks.risk: Cosmetic key yellowing may indicate age-related wear that correlates with internal wear (pots, faders, contacts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the keybed and a test of all faders/knobs in a video.

risks.risk: LCD screen may have dead pixels or dim backlight not visible from this angle.
risks.proof: A straight-on, well-lit photo of the screen showing a menu or patch name clearly.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on from off, showing the full boot screen.
Video demonstrating sound output and pitch-bend/mod wheel function.
Photos of all included accessories (adapter, pedal, stand, manual).
Close-up, well-lit photo of the LCD screen and full key range.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Yamaha MM6 keyboard with visible pitch/mod wheels, but functionality, accessories, and screen condition are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case (non-working, no accessories) until proof is supplied.
